final: WITH joined AS (SELECT c.gender FROM Invoices i INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id), gender_counts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM joined GROUP BY gender), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(count AS FLOAT)) AS overall_average FROM gender_counts WHERE gender IS NOT NULL), kept_groups AS (SELECT gc.count, oavg.overall_average FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oavg WHERE gc.gender IS NOT NULL AND gc.count > oavg.overall_average) SELECT AVG(CAST(count AS FLOAT)) AS avg_of_counts, AVG(CAST(count AS FLOAT) - overall_average) AS avg_of_differences FROM kept_groups
